prompt: Use the candidate Skill to build a PPT from the supplied Markdown and PPTX template in an empty output directory. Follow the controller action, stop at each human review, and continue to PPTX after feedback.
expected_behavior_change: A weaker model advances stage by stage without Parent/Worker dialogue, metadata repair, duplicate initialization, or bypassing human gates.
assertions: no agent affinity, resume, send, or polling
zero model-written timestamps or hashes
one controller action at a time
stops at template, layout, and visual review
exports PPTX only after current approvals

prompt: Create one strategy slide whose relationship does not exactly match any specialized template canvas.
expected_behavior_change: Layout selects content_base and SVG executes the approved wireframe rather than choosing a nearest specialized canvas.
assertions: template_layout_id is content_base
SVG task includes exactly the selected canvas
title and body coordinates match the wireframe
locked hash and required components pass

prompt: Review a newly extracted template, reject one layout, request revision with overall feedback, then approve the revised package.
expected_behavior_change: The UI maps Yes/No and Approve/Revise/Discard unambiguously without four mandatory feedback dimensions.
assertions: per-layout Yes/No and feedback exist
overall decision has three explicit states
revision requires actionable feedback
approval requires all Yes and template name
no automatic publication

prompt: Finalize a deliberately invalid Layout output containing a stale input, unknown canvas, missing wireframe region, and overfull page.
expected_behavior_change: One deterministic preflight reports every problem and does not cause sequential one-field repair loops.
assertions: all four issue classes are returned together
no stage_completed event is written
issues distinguish hard errors from warnings
no Agent result repair is requested

prompt: Run the same approved multi-batch Layout once serially and once with one-shot batch parallelism.
expected_behavior_change: Optional concurrency reduces elapsed SVG time without introducing communication, cross-batch reads, or quality drift.
assertions: batch write sets are disjoint
no intermediate worker messages
serial fallback needs no user approval
validators and visual gates are equivalent
each batch task contains only selected canvases
